headline: UAE Golden Visa 2026: Requirements, Categories & Costs
metaDescription: UAE Golden Visa 2026: AED 30,000 salary, AED 2M property, entrepreneur AED 500K. 10-year categories, documents and common rejections explained.

sections.content:
The UAE Golden Visa is a long-term residency visa that lets foreigners live, work and study in the UAE without a local sponsor. Most categories grant a 10-year renewable visa, while entrepreneurs and some student categories receive 5 years.

Unlike a standard work visa, the Golden Visa is self-sponsored: you do not lose residency if you change jobs or leave the UAE for extended periods. The visa also covers your spouse and children, making it popular with senior professionals and investors relocating families.
sections.title: What the UAE Golden Visa Offers

sections.content:
Skilled professionals — the route most applicants use — need a monthly basic salary of AED 30,000 (about USD 8,170), a bachelor's degree attested by the UAE Ministry of Education, and a MOHRE skill level 1 or 2 occupation. Real estate investors qualify with property worth AED 2,000,000 or more at DLD-certified value, and public investors with AED 2,000,000 in an accredited fund or company capital.

Entrepreneurs need a project worth at least AED 500,000 approved by an accredited incubator, or an SME generating AED 1,000,000 in annual revenue. Scientists, doctors, creatives, athletes and PhD holders qualify through endorsement by the relevant UAE authority, while outstanding students need 95% or higher in UAE secondary school or a 3.5 to 3.8 GPA.
sections.title: Main Categories and Requirements for 2026

sections.content:
The AED 30,000 salary test applies to your basic salary in the MOHRE contract, not your total package. Many applicants earning AED 45,000 a month are rejected because their contract shows a small basic plus housing and transport allowances — check the split before paying any fees.

Your degree must be attested by the UAE Ministry of Education. The attestation chain — home-country foreign ministry, UAE embassy, and MOFA in the UAE — takes two to four weeks and costs roughly AED 600 to 1,000, so start early rather than after you have a job offer in hand.
sections.title: The Salary Test and Degree Attestation

sections.content:
Apply under the category that matches your profile on the official UAE government portal or ICP channels — choosing the wrong category is the most common reason applications stall. Property investors file through the emirate's land department and GDRFA, while skilled professionals apply through ICP or GDRFA channels.

After in-principle approval, complete the medical fitness test and apply for your Emirates ID. Dubai and federal routes are separate frameworks with different thresholds in some categories, so confirm which authority processes your emirate's applications before you pay any fee.
